Settings.Description_ENG: Auto-extracted schema for Morale_Settings.INI. Descriptions come from the INI file's own ; comments. Generated by ja2-launcher/tools/build_ini_schemas.py.

Property.name: DEFAULT_MORALE
Property.Description_ENG: default morale, that merc's will eventually stabilise at in typical conditions (0-100)

Property.name: HOURS_BETWEEN_STRATEGIC_DECAY
Property.Description_ENG: how long, before strategic (prolonged) morale effect will deteriorate towards default

Section.name: Tactical Morale Settings
Section.Description_ENG: Specify how much morale merce lose/gain in certain events. All values from -100 to 100.

Property.name: MORALE_KILLED_ENEMY
Property.Description_ENG: short term effect

Property.name: MORALE_SQUADMATE_DIED
Property.Description_ENG: in same sector (not really squad)... IN ADDITION to strategic loss of morale

Property.name: MORALE_SUPPRESSED
Property.Description_ENG: up to 4 times per turn

Property.name: MORALE_ALCOHOL_CRASH
Property.Description_ENG: Flugente: lowered as drugs can have several components that have a backlash, causing the the morale to plummet drastical

Property.name: MORALE_PSYCHO_UNABLE_TO_PSYCHO
Property.Description_ENG: added by SANDRO

Property.name: MORALE_FOOD
Property.Description_ENG: added by Flugente

Property.name: MORALE_KILLED_CIVILIAN
Property.Description_ENG: long term effect (influenced by HOURS_BETWEEN_STRATEGIC_DECAY)

Property.name: MORALE_RAN_AWAY
Property.Description_ENG: ran from sector during battle

Property.name: MORALE_RAN_AWAY_COWARD
Property.Description_ENG: cowards can actually gain morale by running away

Property.name: MORALE_ENEMYGROUP_COWARD
Property.Description_ENG: penalty for cowards upon meeting hostiles in strategic that outnumber our forces by a factor >= 2

Property.name: MORALE_TOWN_LIBERATED
Property.Description_ENG: town sector, not entire town

Property.name: MORALE_TEAMMATE_DIED
Property.Description_ENG: not in same sector

Property.name: MORALE_MERC_MARRIED
Property.Description_ENG: when merc gets married to Hicks, other mercs' reaction (double for very sexist women)

Property.name: MORALE_HEAT_INTOLERANT_IN_DESERT
Property.Description_ENG: added by SANDRO

Property.name: MORALE_BUDDY_FIRED
Property.Description_ENG: added by anv

Property.name: MORALE_BUDDY_FIRED_EARLY
Property.Description_ENG: in addition to MORALE_BUDDY_FIRED

Property.name: MORALE_BUDDY_FIRED_ON_BAD_TERMS
Property.Description_ENG: in addition to MORALE_BUDDY_FIRED

Property.name: MORALE_BAD_EQUIPMENT
Property.Description_ENG: when equipment is worse than personal preference

Property.name: MORALE_OWED_MONEY
Property.Description_ENG: not paid for at least 3 days (only MERC mercs can not be paid without quitting though)

Property.name: MORALE_PLAYER_INACTIVE
Property.Description_ENG: player was inactive

Property.name: MORALE_PLAYER_INACTIVE_DAYS
Property.Description_ENG: how long, before merc starts to whine about inactivity (0-100, 0 = infinite)

Property.name: MORALE_PREVENTED_MISBEHAVIOUR
Property.Description_ENG: merc was prevented from getting drunk, high or scrounging

Property.name: MORALE_MOD_MAX
Property.Description_ENG: limits maximum range < -MORALE_MOD_MAX, MORALE_MOD_MAX > of morale change during hourly update (0-100)

Property.name: MORALE_MODIFIER_SOCIABLE_ONE_MERC_NEARBY
Property.Description_ENG: modifiers to morale gain depending on merc character (only if new trait system is on) note: can't change a positive event into negative and negative event into a positive one!

Property.name: MORALE_MODIFIER_AGRESSIVE_VIOLENT_ACTION
Property.Description_ENG: includes: MORALE_KILLED_ENEMY, MORALE_DID_LOTS_OF_DAMAGE, MORALE_MONSTER_QUEEN_KILLED, MORALE_DEIDRANNA_KILLED

Property.name: MORALE_MODIFIER_PACIFIST_VIOLENT_ACTION
Property.Description_ENG: includes: MORALE_KILLED_ENEMY, MORALE_DID_LOTS_OF_DAMAGE, MORALE_MONSTER_QUEEN_KILLED, MORALE_DEIDRANNA_KILLED, MORALE_BATTLE_WON, MORALE_HEARD_BATTLE_WON, MORALE_HATED_DIED, MORALE_QUEEN_BATTLE_WON

Property.name: MORALE_MODIFIER_OT_OPTIMIST_GOOD_EVENT
Property.Description_ENG: only old trait system all but MORALE_PSYCHO_UNABLE_TO_PSYCHO and MORALE_MALICIOUS_HIT

Property.name: MORALE_MODIFIER_OT_OPTIMIST_BAD_EVENT
Property.Description_ENG: only old trait system all but MORALE_PSYCHO_UNABLE_TO_PSYCHO

Property.name: MORALE_MODIFIER_MALICIOUS_HOURLY_DECAY
Property.Description_ENG: SANDRO - morale is going down faster if not fighting for malicious characters modifies morale change for malicious mercs during hourly update

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_FRIENDLYFIRE
Property.Description_ENG: if someone else did something to us, our opinion of them is modified values between -50 and 0 for bad stuff and 0 and 50 for good stuff If a modifier is set to 0, this event is not used, thereby allowing to turn specific events off. friendly fire

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_SNITCHSOLDMEOUT
Property.Description_ENG: a snitch told the player about our complaining

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_SNITCHINTERFERENCE
Property.Description_ENG: a snitch stopped us from stealing/taking drugs

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_FRIENDSWITHHATED
Property.Description_ENG: someone else is friends with someone we really don't like

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_CONTRACTEXTENSION
Property.Description_ENG: someone else got a contract extension before we did, even though we had less time to begin with

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_ORDEREDRETREAT
Property.Description_ENG: we blame our leader for a retreat order

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_CIVKILLER
Property.Description_ENG: someone killed a non-hostile civilian/militia

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_SLOWSUSDOWN
Property.Description_ENG: someone carries too much and slows down the squad

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_NOSHARINGFOOD
Property.Description_ENG: we are hungry and someone else has food and obviously does not share

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_ANNOYINGDISABILITY
Property.Description_ENG: someone else's disability kicked in

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_ADDICT
Property.Description_ENG: other merc is an addict and consumes drugs

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_THIEF
Property.Description_ENG: other merc is stealing

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_WORSTCOMMANDEREVER
Property.Description_ENG: we blame our leader for huge battle losses

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_RICHGUY
Property.Description_ENG: someone else earns a lot more, we feel it's unfair. See also WAGE_ACCEPTANCE_FACTOR in JA2_Options.ini

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_BETTERGEAR
Property.Description_ENG: Someone else has way better gear than we do

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_YOUMOUNTEDAGUNONMYBREASTS
Property.Description_ENG: someone else used our body as a rifle rest

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_BANDAGED
Property.Description_ENG: someone treated our wounds, also counts for doctoring

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_DRINKBUDDIES_GOOD
Property.Description_ENG: each time mercs drink alcohol together, this can go either good (67%) or bad (33%). Good on good causes super, bad on bad causes worse. Bad and good cancel each other out.

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_AGAINST_US
Property.Description_ENG: sometimes another mercs can interject in an ongoing argument. If it is an IMP, the player can choose what to say There is a chance that parties in the argument alter their opinion towards the 'interjector' depending on the statement someone argued against/for us

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_AGAINST_ENEMY
Property.Description_ENG: someone argued against/for the other side of the argument

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_SOLVECONFLICT_REASON_GOOD
Property.Description_ENG: someone attempted to solve the argument by taking a reasonable stance, and we like/dislike that

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_SOLVECONFLICT_AGGRESSIVE_GOOD
Property.Description_ENG: someone attempted to solve the argument by taking an aggressive stance, and we like/dislike that

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_DISEASE_DISGUSTING
Property.Description_ENG: someone is sick, and we find that disgusting (whether disease is disgusting can be set in Disease.xml)

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_DISEASE_TREATMENT
Property.Description_ENG: someone treated our disease

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_BRUTAL_GOOD
Property.Description_ENG: someone killed someone in a brutal fashion, and we like/dislike that

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_TEACHER
Property.Description_ENG: someone taught us and we are grateful

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_BESTCOMMANDEREVER
Property.Description_ENG: our leader led us to a magnificent victory

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_BATTLE_SAVIOUR
Property.Description_ENG: someone saved us in battle by killing whoever attacked (and likely wounded) us

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_FRAGTHIEF
Property.Description_ENG: someone stole our kill. That guy was OURs to take down!

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_BATTLE_ASSIST
Property.Description_ENG: someone helped us take down an enemy

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_BATTLE_TOOK_PRISONER
Property.Description_ENG: someone captured the enemy instead of killing them, and we approve

Property.name: OPINIONEVENT_CIV_ATTACKER
Property.Description_ENG: someone injured a non-hostile civilian/militia
